event: synchronous audio shutdown and queued audio-command cleanup

caller.condition: audio command byte 1 equals 0xff and hrtimer_active is true

lifetime.queued_nodes_created_by: haptic_audio_store allocates 0x18-byte nodes and inserts their list_head at haptic+0x590

concurrency.caller_audio_mutex: haptic+0x4f0 is held by haptic_audio_store when it calls audio_off
concurrency.whole_driver_lock_order: UNRESOLVED; audio_work_routine also processes the same list under its audio mutex

limitations: The target is synchronous, but interactions with concurrent audio work need full lock/lifetime analysis.
